tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground and the canvas behind the daisy field. Most of every screen.

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: The block that stands in for a missing photo, and the footer. Nothing else.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines on paper or chalk. Never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, the logo and control borders, on paper, chalk and daisy. The black of the shirt print.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Captions and metadata, on paper and chalk.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The collar colour. The daisy field, links, the focus ring and the one dark surface; as text, on paper, chalk and daisy.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and the logo on a navy surface.

tokens.name: daisy
tokens.usage: The accent, a flat fill that appears only on interaction: the highlight behind a hovered or selected line. Text on it is ink. As text, only on navy.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The team name, as printed on the shirt. Always uppercase. Large on the home canvas only.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: One per page: a season or section title. Uppercase.

styles.name: list
styles.usage: The centred lists that make up most pages: seasons, then the names in a season.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Eleven games, three wins, one rainout.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep it to a few lines.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Photo from the last game of the season.
styles.usage: Photo credits, footnotes and the footer.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The small line under a list item: a record, a year, a jersey number.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a list item and its caption; inside buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between list items; the header's inset from the page edge; gutters.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between blocks within a page; the clear space around the logo.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between page sections, and above and below a headline.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, panels, buttons and highlights. The default: everything is square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The dots in the daisy field. Nothing in the interface.
